themes.description: Users are experiencing frequent issues with viewing and interacting with charts on the platform. The chart view is not loading correctly, charts are not saving, and zooming functionality is not working properly. This is affecting users' ability to accurately view and analyze market data.
themes.business_impact: Frequent chart functionality issues are causing users to have an inaccurate view of market data, leading to potentially poor investment decisions and a negative experience on the platform.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The chart functionality issues may be caused by a combination of factors including, but not limited to, bugs in the chart rendering engine, issues with data storage and retrieval, and incompatibilities with different screen sizes and orientations.
themes.action_plan:
• Identify and fix bugs in the chart rendering engine
• Optimize data storage and retrieval for improved chart loading times
• Investigate and resolve issues with chart saving and restore functionality
• Ensure chart zooming and panning functionality is optimized across different screen sizes and orientations.

themes.description: Users are experiencing frequent technical issues with the platform, causing problems with order executions, account verification, and money withdrawal, which is further compounded by poor customer support.
themes.business_impact: Delays and cancellations of trades, loss of revenue due to inefficient money withdrawal processes, and reputational damage from frustrated customers.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient infrastructure capacity, inadequate testing, and inefficient support processes are exacerbating user frustrations.
themes.action_plan: • Enhance infrastructure scalability, implement robust backup and contingency procedures, and redesign the customer support workflow to provide more efficient and proactive assistance.

themes.description: The app crashes frequently, taking an extended period of time to load or resulting in a timeout. This also leads to an inability to perform tasks due to technical issues.
themes.business_impact: Substantial loss of user trust due to frequent downtimes. It also poses a risk that users might abandon the app, opting for more stable alternatives.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause is likely an issue with the app's architecture or performance optimizations.
themes.action_plan:
• Investigate the root cause
• Optimize the app's architecture for better performance
• Conduct rigorous testing
• Implement robust backup systems and recovery processes.
